title: 追試とかいう重ね塗り

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking down the hallway when I hear someone come up quickly behind me.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Trainer! I'd like to discuss Jordan's recent exam with you…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What's up? You need me for something?
choice_data_list: I hear you failed your exam.
I hear you failed your exam.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Teehee. ☆
choice_data_list: It's not funny. We need to prepare for the makeup.
It's not funny. We need to prepare for the makeup.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "We"? Oh come on, seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Students typically have to keep retaking tests until they manage to pass, so the longer that takes, the less time they have to practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Passing a test also provides a sense of accomplishment, which is sure to have a positive effect on her growth as a runner.
choice_data_list: Don't you want to "win" the test?
Don't you want to "win" the test?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You really think making it like a race is gonna motivate me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan is having a staring contest with the question sheet on her desk.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ummm… uhhh…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I've got no clue… What do I write?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I don't know the formula. Like, there's way too much stuff to remember…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, she failed because she couldn't memorize the material well enough.
choice_data_list: In that case, let's try studying while you move your body!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Um… What's this?
choice_data_list: Try reading it aloud while doing some light running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hand her a notepad with all the formulas she needs to know for the makeup test.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: While running? No way! That's so embarrassing! Not happening!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Science tells us that light exercise can aid in memorization. For an Umamusume, studying while running sounds perfect.
choice_data_list: So you're just going to let this test beat you?
So you're just going to let this test beat you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No fair! Don't say it like that!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Tangent! Equals! Sine over cosine!
choice_data_list: What's the equation for motion?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uhhhh, F=ma?!
choice_data_list: You've got it!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Great job, Jordan! You passed all your makeup tests!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Great job? I know. I'm just too good, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, mostly because my trainer made me do this silly exercise.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Oh, you got study tips from your trainer? Does that mean there's a secret study method that works on you? I'll have to ask for the details.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …I really don't think that's a good idea. Copying Trainer is not gonna be a good look.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Honestly… I don't think I'd listen if anyone else told me to do that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a glance at the problem Tosen Jordan is working through. It looks like a mathematical proof.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So n is an odd number, which means n is 2k + 1, and then…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Something seems off. What was it the teacher said earlier…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan pulls out her eraser and completely erases her partially solved equation.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh…
choice_data_list: Why did you erase everything?
Why did you erase everything?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Cause I was definitely doing it wrong. Why bother when you know it's gonna get a big fat red X?
choice_data_list: You should write it out, even if it's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since it's a proof, she can still get partial credit for the correct parts even if she ends up with the wrong answer.
choice_data_list: I'd also like your teacher to see how hard you're working.
I'd also like your teacher to see how hard you're working.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh… You really are a trainer through and through.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Just what I said.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan continues working diligently on her practice problems.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I just barely failed my makeup test. Gotta do it again.
choice_data_list: That's too bad…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But I'll definitely get it next time. Even my teacher said so, because I've been working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get the feeling she's more motivated than usual in her training today.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So, real talk, do you think studying is, like, important?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I bet you can't solve these problems either. Be honest, you've forgotten all these formulas, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan looks at me doubtfully, so I glance at her test.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The subject appears to be math, specifically probability. Looking more closely, it involves combinations, which means…
choice_data_list: Uhh, what was that formula again?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I knew it! You don't remember!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's like all the knowledge flew out of my head as soon as I looked at it. I was pretty good with math when I was in school…
choice_data_list: But I do remember that I studied hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Yeah?
choice_data_list: That's probably why I'm still able to study now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Now? …Oh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Do trainers have things they have to study too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: All right, I'll do some reviewing!
All right, I'll do some reviewing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take out a notepad and write down the problem that she's been working on.
choice_data_list: Let's see who can solve it first!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! We're competing?! H-hang on a sec!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You've already started working on it! Cheater! No false starts!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Let me get this straight… You'd like to take the makeup test as well?
choice_data_list: I think that'll really get Jordan motivated!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Are you out of your mind?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As for the results… Well, let's just say it was a good competition for the both of us.
